reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so I have an actual reason to try it, and a named lab with the report for my batch is the first time a supplement ad answered my question. At $24.99 for one box with a money-back guarantee, I'll try one and not a second until I see how I feel.
objection: A lab report on a page doesn't prove much until I can check the lab is real and the batch number on the box matches. Also my doctor never said to take this brand, and I'm not sure I need 200 mg.
would_change_my_mind: If I could not find the named lab or the report did not match the batch number on the box, I would pass. Hearing from my doctor that magnesium was not actually low would also stop me.
